item.title: Crocodile vs Black Mamba: The Gamble That Shouldn't Work
item.description:
Made with Restream Studio. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io
Strength has never lost to size in the animal kingdom — until venom enters the equation. When a Nile crocodile locks onto Africa's most feared snake, it isn't just picking a fight. It's making a bet that its own biology might not survive. The black mamba delivers one of the fastest-acting neurotoxins on the planet, fast enough to kill prey many times its size within minutes. So why does the crocodile still take the risk? The real outcome — backed by what herpetologists and crocodile researchers have actually documented — isn't the one most people assume.

item.title: Battle of Paws | Lions vs Crocodiles: The Truth Scientists Confirmed
item.description:
Lions vs crocodiles — the confrontation everyone assumes they understand, and the science that proves most of it wrong. This is Episode 3 of the Lion vs Crocodile Files.
For years, footage of lions and crocodiles clashing at the water's edge has been treated as simple predator-vs-predator drama. But recent research reveals something scientists didn't expect about who actually controls these encounters, and why the outcome has less to do with size and strength than you'd think.In this episode, we break down the real biology and behavior behind lion vs crocodile confrontations — territory, water-edge ambush tactics, and the specific factors that actually determine survival.
